summary: CL Workshop Group Limited, a Macau-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing an at-the-market sales agreement dated September 30, 2026 with Chaince Securities, LLC as sales agent for up to $200 million of American Depositary Shares, each representing eight Class A Ordinary Shares. Sales occur under an effective Form F-3 shelf (No. 333-297543) at the company's discretion, with a 3.0% commission plus 1.0% expense allowance. Proceeds fund working capital and product development. This is a routine shelf takedown facility, not a special situation; no board recommendation or premium applies. Watch dilution and ADS overhang.
